title: Risk management officer
description:
About Us
Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.
Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.
As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.
Key Responsibilities:
Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
Net-worth monitoring;
Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.
Requirements:
Legally resident in Brazil.
Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function. Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements. Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English . Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including: not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
unblemished reputation;
knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Account manager
description:
LOVE startups and always dreamed of working in tech?
WANT to become a disrupter, tackling one of the world’s biggest problems?
BELIEVE you can use your skills to help change the world?
Oneday is a VC-backed Ed Tech company that supports aspiring entrepreneurs from all corners of society to launch their dream business, with expert support from a mentor, a deep curriculum of content, and a vibrant community of business founders.
We have raised $20 M+ in funding from the UK's and Silicon Valley's leading VCs. Our launch phase has been extremely successful and we have reached a stage to take the next step in driving further awareness and intent for our growing range of products.
We’re looking for Account Managers to join our inbound sales team and own the early-stage founder experience.
What you’ll do..
As an Account Manager, you’ll be responsible for managing warm inbound leads from start to finish:
Conduct high-quality discovery calls with founders who’ve already shown interest
Understand what they’re building, why it matters, and where they’re stuck
Clearly position Oneday’s programs and mentorship
Confidently handle objections and guide qualified founders to the next step
Book next-step calls and keep your pipeline clean and updated
Work in a high-volume environment (150–250 calls/day) while staying sharp
Track your performance and continuously improve conversion rates
This is not a passive customer success role.
It’s a performance-driven, ownership-heavy sales role where outcomes matter.
You’ll likely do well here if you:
Have experience in sales, account management, or customer-facing roles (startup experience is a big plus)
Are comfortable on the phone and can build rapport quickly
Think in terms of numbers, conversion rates, and improvement
Can stay organised and disciplined in a fast-moving environment
Take feedback well and apply it
Have strong written and spoken English skills
Are resilient, proactive, and take ownership of results
What you’ll get:
Unparalleled experience of working for a hyper-growth startup
Having fun and learning from your more experienced colleagues — serial entrepreneurs, investors and engineers
Fully remote working environment
Fantastic opportunity to get to know hundreds of founders and executives in the world on a first name basis

title: Risk management officer
description:
About Us
Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.
Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.
As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.
Key Responsibilities:
Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
Net-worth monitoring;
Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.
Requirements:
Legally resident in Brazil.
Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function. Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements. Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English . Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including: not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
unblemished reputation;
knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Sap basis upgrades sum and conversion specialist
description:
We are seeking skilled SAP Basis Experts to execute complex SAP system upgrades and conversions, The ideal candidate will have deep technical expertise in SAP Basis, a strong understanding of SAP architecture, and hands-on experience with SAP system conversions, upgrades, copies and migrations . Key Responsibilities: 7+ years of Basis Experience Plan and execute SAP system upgrades (Net Weaver, EHP, SPS, Kernel) across development, quality, and production environments. Lead SAP S/4 HANA system conversions from ECC, including pre-checks, simplification item analysis, and custom code remediation. Utilize tools such as SUM (Software Update Manager) , Maintenance Planner , DMO (Database Migration Option) , and SPAM/SAINT . Experience in Update, System copies and Client copies
Perform OS/DB migrations , Unicode conversions, and HANA database upgrades. Conduct mock conversions , dry runs, and cutover planning for production migrations. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure compatibility and readiness for upgrades and conversions.
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues during and post-upgrade/conversion.
Maintain comprehensive documentation of upgrade/conversion procedures and lessons learned.
Stay current with SAP’s roadmap, release strategy, and best practices for upgrades and conversions.
ECS experience is added advantage

ECS experience is added advantage

title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
About Rate Gain
Rate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.
Exploring the role
Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.
The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.
This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.
How your day will look like/Job responsibility
Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
Represent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends
Education & Work Experience
Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships
Knowledge:
In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
Knowledge of Saa S business models and partnership structures
Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors
Skills:
Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)
Attitude:
Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment
Equal Opportunity Employer
We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

title: Power platform developer
description:
POSITION TITLE: Microsoft Power Platform Developer (individual contractor 6 – 12-month term with the possibility of extension, remote in Brazil)
JOB OVERVIEW:
Working with our IT team to develop Power Platform solutions and provide technical support for the Power Platform systems. We are seeking a skilled Microsoft Power Apps Developer to join our dynamic IT team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and supporting business applications using Microsoft Power Apps and Power Automate. This role requires a deep understanding of Power Platform, business process approval workflow, to create efficient and scalable solutions that meet our business needs.
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Design, develop and maintain Power Platform Applications (specifically Dynamics) and related components (e.g., Power Apps, Power Automate).
• Experience writing and maintaining Power Platform flows for automation and system efficiency.
• Build APIs and integrations to connect external systems and implement business logic and flows.
• Integrate Power Platform with other Microsoft services including Power BI, and Share Point.
• Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
• Create and maintain documentation for developed applications and processes.
• Provide technical support and troubleshooting for Power Platform solutions.
• Conduct training sessions and workshops for end-users to ensure effective utilization of developed applications.
• Working remotely cover 4 hours of US Pacific time zone (between 9:00am – 5:00pm PST).
JOB QUALIFICATIONS:
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
• Proven experience in developing applications using Microsoft Power Platform.
• Strong knowledge of Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI and API.
• Experience with Microsoft Share Point, Microsoft Dynamics, and other Microsoft services.
• Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills in English.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Microsoft Power Platform certification is preferred.
WORK LOCATION:
Remote in Brazil

Tutors in this project work in freelance mode and can decide the number of hours they wish to work.
Do you prefer to work in the morning, in the evening, for a few hours or many hours? The choice is yours. You can log in at any time to help students. In addition, you can work from anywhere, as long as you have a computer with a reliable Internet connection.
We need tutors who can start immediately!
Characteristics
Payment in dollars.

Schedule: Flexible, free choice
Start: Immediate
Duration: Indefinite
Requirements

Ability to solve university-level questions in at least one of the following subjects:
General Chemistry
Organic Chemistry
Student or graduate of a university course whose curriculum includes at least one of the subjects listed in the previous point.
Computer with an Internet connection.
No criminal record.

title: Salesforce business system analyst
description:
Job Title: Salesforce Business Systems Analyst (BSA)
Location: LATAM
Duration: 6-12months
Job Summary:
We are looking for a Salesforce Business Systems Analyst (BSA) with strong experience in gathering business requirements, translating them into functional specifications, and supporting Salesforce implementation and enhancements. The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to deliver scalable Salesforce solutions that support business processes.
Key Responsibilities:
·Work with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements for Salesforce implementations and enhancements.
·Translate business needs into functional requirements, user stories, and process flows .
·Act as a bridge between business teams and technical teams to ensure accurate implementation of requirements.
·Configure and support Salesforce features including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, workflows, validation rules, reports, and dashboards .
·Participate in solution design discussions and recommend best practices within the Salesforce ecosystem.
·Support UAT (User Acceptance Testing) by preparing test cases, coordinating with stakeholders, and ensuring requirements are met.
·Assist in data migration, integration requirements, and system documentation .
·Provide production support and troubleshooting for Salesforce issues.
·Maintain clear documentation including BRDs, FRDs, user stories, and process diagrams .
·Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement and system optimization .
Required Qualifications:
·3–6 years of experience as a Business Analyst with Salesforce platform exposure .
·Strong understanding of Salesforce Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud .
·Experience with requirements gathering, documentation, and stakeholder management .
·Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies .
·Ability to create user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications .
·Experience with Salesforce reporting, dashboards, and basic configuration .
·Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills

title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
About Rate Gain
Rate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.
Exploring the role
Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.
The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.
This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.
How your day will look like/Job responsibility
Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
Represent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends
Education & Work Experience
Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships
Knowledge:
In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
Knowledge of Saa S business models and partnership structures
Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors
Skills:
Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)
Attitude:
Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment
Equal Opportunity Employer
We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

title: Game presenter
description:
✨ Game Presenter em São Paulo
Vem brilhar diante das câmeras em uma empresa líder em tecnologia!
Salário competitivo + bônus por performance
Make & styling profissionais todos os dias
️ Estúdio moderno em SP
Time internacional, vibe dinâmica e crescimento real
⭐ Sem experiência? Relaxa — a gente te transforma em estrela!
Pronto(a) para brilhar? Candidate-se agora!
Sobre a empresa
Somos uma empresa líder em tecnologia que redefine padrões de qualidade no setor de i Gaming, entregando experiências incríveis para milhões de jogadores ao redor do mundo.
Com mais de 12.000 profissionais em países como Canadá, Índia, Malta, Romênia, Sérvia, Colômbia, Emirados Árabes e muito mais, estamos moldando o futuro do entretenimento digital — e você pode fazer parte disso.
O que é um Game Presenter?
É você quem comanda o jogo ao vivo : apresenta, interage, distribui cartas e cria uma experiência envolvente para jogadores online.
Não precisa ter experiência — você recebe treinamento completo no nosso novo estúdio em Santo Amaro, com ambiente moderno e super tecnológico.
O estúdio funciona 24/7 , então você escolhe os turnos que combinam com sua rotina.
O que você vai fazer Ser o centro das atenções , apresentando Blackjack com carisma e profissionalismo Brilhar diante das câmeras com confiança (a gente te treina para isso!)
Manter ritmo, foco e boa energia trabalhando com um time global
Criar uma experiência tão boa que os jogadores vão querer voltar sempre
O que esperamos de você
Português nativo
Inglês intermediário (B2)
Disponibilidade para turnos flexíveis
Vontade de ser o rosto da marca e entregar entretenimento de qualidade
Habilidades de apresentação (ou vontade de aprender rapidinho!)
O que oferecemos Salário fixo competitivo Benefícios como transporte e outros Treinamento completo + workshops de desenvolvimento Learning Hub com oportunidades reais de crescimento Estúdio incrível em um prédio icônico de São Paulo Aparições diante das câmeras e evolução contínua das suas skills de apresentação

title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
About Rate Gain
Rate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.
Exploring the role
Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.
The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.
This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.
How your day will look like/Job responsibility
Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
Represent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends
Education & Work Experience
Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships
Knowledge:
In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
Knowledge of Saa S business models and partnership structures
Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors
Skills:
Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)
Attitude:
Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment
Equal Opportunity Employer
We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

description:

Working with our IT team to develop Power Platform solutions and provide technical support for the Power Platform systems. • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
• Proven experience in developing applications using Microsoft Power Platform.
• Strong knowledge of Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI and API.
• Experience with Microsoft Share Point, Microsoft Dynamics, and other Microsoft services.
• Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills in English.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Microsoft Power Platform certification is preferred.
WORK LOCATION:
Remote in Brazil

title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
About Rate Gain
Rate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.
Exploring the role
Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.
The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.
This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.
How your day will look like/Job responsibility
Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
Represent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends
Education & Work Experience
Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships
Knowledge:
In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
Knowledge of Saa S business models and partnership structures
Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors
Skills:
Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)
Attitude:
Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

title: B2b appointment setter - uncapped income (base + pay per call)
description:
B2 B Appointment Setter - Uncapped Income (Base + Pay Per Call) Connect With Us:

Linked In:
Twitter/X:
Company: gpsocials.com  
This position is fully remote. We're specifically hiring from LATAM and you must be available to work EST business hours for real-time collaboration.
The Opportunity: Why GP Socials
We're not just another content agency. We're a fully remote content growth partner managing 100,000+ followers and generating hundreds of thousands of monthly views for our B2 B clients. Some of whom are making $8,000,000+ in annual revenue. Plus, we've tripled our own revenue in the last year.
Here's What Makes Us Different:
Proven Growth Track Record : We've 3x'd our business while maintaining quality - our clients' content actually generates leads and builds brands ⚡ Small Team = Massive Growth Potential : Work directly with the founder, acquire skills rapidly, and shape the trajectory of a fast-scaling agency
Real Impact, Real Results : The calls you book directly fuel our growth and put you at the center of every new client we sign. Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It):
You'll own the top of our sales pipeline - turning Linked In conversations and inbound leads into booked calls on Braden's calendar. This isn't about spray-and-pray outreach or copy-paste scripts. You'll build real conversations with B2 B founders and marketers, qualify them fast, and hand off warm, ready-to-buy prospects. Every call you book is a shot at a high paying client for GP Socials.
The Role: B2 B Appointment Setter Core Responsibilities:
1. Linked In Outbound & Conversation Management
Run daily Linked In outreach to qualified B2 B founders, marketers, and decision-makers
Use AI to personalize opening messages based on the prospect's content, company, and role (no generic blasts)
Manage 50-100+ active Linked In conversations at a time without dropping threads
Handle objections in DMs and move qualified prospects toward a booked call
Track every conversation in our CRM with clear status, notes, and next steps 2. Inbound Lead Follow-Up
Respond to inbound leads from our content, referrals, and marketing FAST
Qualify leads against our ICP (B2 B businesses doing $1 M-$10 M in revenue)
Book discovery calls directly onto Braden's calendar
Send pre-call confirmations and reduce no-show rates with reminder sequences 3. Pipeline Hygiene & Reporting
Keep the CRM clean: accurate stages, follow-up tasks, and conversation history
Report daily on outreach sent, replies, booked calls, and show rates
Flag patterns in objections and reply data so we can sharpen our messaging
Follow written SOPs for outreach cadences, qualification, and handoff Who You Are: Non-Negotiables & Must-Haves
Deal-Makers (You Need ALL of These):
✅ B2 B Agency or Saa S Setting Experience: I do not care about years worked. All I care about is if you have booked calls with B2 B businesses
✅ Writes Like a Human: You can write DMs that sound like a real person, not a bot. You understand tone, pacing, and how to earn a reply in 2-3 sentences.
✅ Fluent Written English: Your written English is clean enough that founders in the US won't clock you as a non-native speaker over DM. (Spoken English is a plus, but writing is the non-negotiable.)
✅ CRM Discipline: You don't forget follow-ups, you don't lose threads, and you can be trusted to keep the pipeline clean without reminders. I should be able to look in the CRM and understand everything
✅ Availability: Available to work EST business hours (9am-5pm EST) Monday-Friday for real-time collaboration and inbound response. Deal-Breakers (Any of These = Not a Fit):
❌ No proven B2 B setting experience 
❌ Rely on copy-paste templates and mass-blast tactics
❌ Written English that reads as broken, stiff, or obviously AI-generated
❌ Can't show specific numbers (calls booked, show rate, deals closed-won) from a previous setting role
❌ Unwilling to work EST hours or live inside a CRM all day
❌ Looking for a passive role You're Perfect If You:
Get fired up about finding the exact line that makes a cold prospect say "yeah, let's talk"
Think in reply rates, show rates, and close rates - not just messages sent
Treat DMs like a craft, not a grind
Have run setting for a B2 B agency or Saa S before and can talk about what worked and what flopped The Package: What's In It for You
Compensation:
Base: $1,500 USD/month
Performance Bonus: $50 USD per booked call that shows up to the discovery call
Our Target: 20+ booked calls per month (realistic earnings $2,500+/month, uncapped)
The more calls you book, the more we make and the more you make. No ceiling.
The Perks:
Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM with a laptop and stable internet
⚡ Work directly with the founder - no sales manager layers, no bureaucracy
Rapid skill acquisition - you'll learn B2 B sales, positioning, and pipeline management from the inside of a scaling agency
Shape our growth - you're the first setter we're hiring. The playbook you help build is the playbook we'll scale. Great to leverage your experience in future endeavors
The Real Benefits:
Book calls for an agency that actually closes them - you won't be stuck in a pipeline where good leads go to die
Work inbound + outbound - you're not just cold-DMing strangers, you're also converting warm leads from real content

title: Senior backend engineer (golang)
description:
OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA
Title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations
Company: Fulcrum Saa S
Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required)
Type: Full-time
Level:  Senior / Staff
Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location
About Fulcrum Saa S
Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.
Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.
The Role
We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.
You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.
You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.
What You’ll Do
Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.
Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.
Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.
Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.
Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.
Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.
Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.
What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)
5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).
Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.
Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.
Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.
Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.
Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.
Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.
Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.
Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.
Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).
Strong Nice-to-Haves
Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).
A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.
Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.
Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.
What We Offer
Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.
Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.
Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.
A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.
How to Apply
Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:
Your experience with Go in production.
The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.
Your country of residence and preferred start date. You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

title: Senior backend engineer (golang)
description:
OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA
Title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations
Company: Fulcrum Saa S
Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required)
Type: Full-time
Level:  Senior / Staff
Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location
About Fulcrum Saa S
Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.
Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.
The Role
We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.
You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.
You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.
What You’ll Do
Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.
Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.
Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.
Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.
Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.
Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.
Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.
What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)
5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).
Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.
Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.
Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.
Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.
Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.
Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.
Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.
Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.
Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).
Strong Nice-to-Haves
Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).
A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.
Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.
Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.
What We Offer
Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.
Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.
Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.
A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.
How to Apply
Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:
Your experience with Go in production.
The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.
Your country of residence and preferred start date. You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

title: Senior backend engineer (golang)
description:
OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA
Title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations
Company: Fulcrum Saa S
Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required)
Type: Full-time
Level:  Senior / Staff
Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location
About Fulcrum Saa S
Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.
Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.
The Role
We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.
You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.
You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.
What You’ll Do
Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.
Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.
Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.
Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.
Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.
Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.
Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.
What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)
5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).
Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.
Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.
Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.
Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.
Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.
Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.
Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.
Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.
Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).
Strong Nice-to-Haves
Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).
A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.
Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.
Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.
What We Offer
Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.
Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.
Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.
A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.

Content Development: Design, tune, and maintain detection logic, correlation rules, and monitoring dashboards within SIEM platforms to maximize coverage and reduce alert noise.
Proactive Hunting: Initiate hypothesis-driven threat hunt campaigns using intelligence feeds, behavioral baselines, and knowledge of adversary tactics drawn from recognized attack frameworks.
Automation: Develop and maintain scripts and tooling (Python, Bash) to accelerate investigative workflows, automate data enrichment, and streamline repetitive SOC tasks.
3. Cross-functional Collaboration & SOC Development
Teamwork: Partner with adjacent teams (infrastructure, cloud, identity management, incident response) during active security events and broader remediation efforts.
Lessons Learned: Actively contribute to post-incident retrospectives, generating actionable recommendations to strengthen security controls and refine processes.
Continuous Improvement: Support tooling upgrades, SOC maturity initiatives, and security projects to keep operational capabilities in step with an evolving threat landscape.

Solid grounding in incident response lifecycle, log analysis techniques, and packet capture (PCAP) examination.
Comprehensive knowledge of core networking protocols and architectures (OSI model, TCP/IP, DNS, SMTP).
Thorough understanding of attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures, with practical familiarity with frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.
Hands-on experience in both Windows and Linux environments, including the ability to identify indicators of compromise and abnormal system behavior.
Proficiency in scripting (Python, Bash) applied to investigation support and process automation.
A proactive, adversarial mindset with a continuous drive toward improved threat detection and defense.

title: Consultor de energia
description:
Sobre a Empresa
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos. Desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC (Forest Stewardship Council) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.
Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.
Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.
Sobre a Função
Gerir, otimizar e monetizar o portfólio energético da Arauco Brasil, incluindo autoprodução e comercialização de excedentes no mercado livre e regulado, atuando na interface entre áreas industrial, financeira e jurídica, buscando maximizar resultados econômicos por meio da gestão eficiente de contratos, análise de mercado e conformidade regulatória.
Responsabilidades
Gerenciar o portfólio de energia da empresa, que inclui geração, consumo, contratos livres e regulados, de curto e longo prazo, convencionais e de autoprodução;
Negociar junto a traders, comercializadoras e agentes do setor a compra e venda de energia;
Monitorar e analisar o mercado de energia (Preços de curto e longo prazo, oferta e demanda, cenários hidrológicos);
Desenvolver estratégias de comercialização do excedente energético e otimizar a alocação de energia entre consumo próprio e venda, visando maximização de receita e redução de custos;
Acompanhar e garantir conformidade com regulamentações do setor elétrico;
Realizar estudos de viabilidade econômica para novos projetos energéticos (biomassa, cogeração, etc.);
Atuar na gestãode riscos (crédito, exposição ao mercado de curto prazo, variação de preços);
Apoiar auditorias e reportes institucionais e de sustentabilidade;
Se relacionar com as instituições do setor elétrico, incluindo ANEEL, ONS, CCEE, Distribuidoras e Transmissoras de Energia;
Contribuir com o planejamento orçamentário e criticar os desvios, bem como elaborar reports para o nível executivo dos resultados da área de energia;
Definir com a gestão, criar e acompanhar KPIs relacionados a energia, custos e receita de energia, realizando análises e auxiliando a gestão em decisões estratégicas;
Desenvolver e automatizar processos de análise de indicadores através de ferramentas avançadas (BI, Excel, ERP);
Propagar, cumprir e fazer cumprir a política de Meio Ambiente, qualidade, Segurança e Saúde Ocupacional, bem como, a política de ética e Compliance, por todos os colaboradores próprios e terceiros, assegurando o cumprimento da legislação e outros compromissos previstos, em todas as atividades produtos e serviços, incluindo os princípios e critérios das normas e ISOs. Local de atuação
São Paulo/ SP Requisitos
Graduação em Engenharia (Elétrica, Energia, Produção), Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas
Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Energia, Regulação do Setor Elétrico ou áreas afins
Conhecimento em Integração Segurança
Conhecimento em Ferramentas da qualidade
Conhecimento em SAP, Power BI
Vivência com autoprodução e/ou cogeração
Experiência com comercialização de energia e gestão de contratos livres e regulados
Conhecimento técnico em Regulação do setor elétrico brasileiro (ANEEL, CCEE, ONS).
Modelos de precificação (Formação do PLD, contratos indexados)
Ferramentas de análise de mercado e modelagem energética
Experiência em gerenciamento de riscos
Conhecimento das regras de autoprodução Diferenciais
Inglês e Espanhol avançado
Experiência em gerenciamento de riscos
Conhecimento das regras de autoprodução

title: Analista de energia
description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos. Desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC (Forest Stewardship Council) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.
Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.
Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.
Sobre a Função
Realizar o suporte operacional, financeiro e regulatório das atividades de energia da Arauco Brasil, com foco no backoffice da comercialização e da autoprodução, atuando na gestão de dados, contabilização, validação de operações na CCEE e acompanhamento dos resultados financeiros do portfólio de energia, garantindo precisão, conformidade e suporte à tomada de decisão.
. Responsabilidades
Realizar o backoffice das operações de energia no ambiente da CCEE, incluindo: acompanhamento das medições de geração e consumo, registro e validações de contratos no Cliq CCEE, conformidade das obrigações financeiras, acompanhamento da contabilização e liquidação financeira da CCEE, consolidação e elaboração de relatórios;

title: Senior backend engineer (golang)
description:
OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA
Title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations
Company: Fulcrum Saa S
Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required)
Type: Full-time
Level:  Senior / Staff
Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location
About Fulcrum Saa S
Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.
Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.
The Role
We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.
You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.
You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.
What You’ll Do
Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.
Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.
Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.
Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.
Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.
Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.
Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.
What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)
5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).
Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.
Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.
Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.
Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.
Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.
Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.
Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.
Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.
Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).
Strong Nice-to-Haves
Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).
A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.
Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.
Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.
What We Offer
Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.
Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.
Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.
A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.
How to Apply
Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:
Your experience with Go in production.
The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.
Your country of residence and preferred start date. You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

title: Solutions account executive
description:

Disponibilidade para visitar clientes presencialmente em São Paulo;

Experiência prévia em vendas, preferencialmente no setor de tecnologia.

Domínio de técnicas de vendas consultivas.

Vivência com vendas B2 B; Competências Comportamentais
Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita.
Proatividade e senso de dono.
Organização e disciplina comercial.
Resiliência e capacidade de lidar com objeções.
Perfil orientado a metas e resultados.
Facilidade para construir relacionamento.
Capacidade de aprender rápido sobre soluções tecnológicas. KPIs de Sucesso
Receita gerada
Taxa de conversão
Número de novas oportunidades criadas

VR/VA: 25/dia em média 750/mês
Vale-transporte ou estacionamento
Assistência médica Amil com co-participação; Proposta:
Fixo (CLT) + comissionamento mediante atingimento de metas;
Incentivos paracertificações e treinamentos técnicos;
Modelo de trabalho presencial quando não está visitando clientes;
Incentivos paracertificações e treinamentos técnicos.

title: Prompt engineer
description:
Descrição da Empresa A Dory IA é uma plataforma inovadora que utiliza inteligência artificial para transformar o mercado imobiliário, criando conexões humanas com rapidez, precisão e empatia. Focamos em entender a jornada de quem compra, vende ou aluga, oferecendo soluções que otimizam o funil de vendas de imobiliárias e corretores por meio de pré-atendimento, qualificação de leads e insights inteligentes. Design e Otimização de Prompts: Experiência na criação e ajuste de prompts para IA e algoritmos de linguagem natural.

Formação na área de tecnologia, inteligência artificial ou áreas correlatas será considerada um diferencial, assim como proficiência em linguagens de programação e experiência no setor imobiliário.

title: Operations director
description:
Kinetic Homes - Operations Director
Introduction:
Kinetic Homes is a homebuilder based in Jacksonville FL focused on expanding homeownership by constructing high quality, affordable homes in vibrant neighborhoods. The business was founded by Erik Nordahl and has built & sold over 100 homes over the past 3 years.
This role will be an early hire in a rapidly growing organization. The individual for this role will report directly to the founder, Erik Nordahl. Mentorship and professional development are critical to Erik, and he will seek to assist his colleagues in their professional development and share the learnings he has accumulated throughout his career. This individual will have opportunity to eventually manage a team of individual contributors in the future.
Compensation: $40,000-90,000 USD per year.
Duties & Responsibilities:
Permitting
Ensure all necessary permits are obtained for new construction projects.
Complete and submit permit applications for new construction.
Assist with septic permits and HOA applications.
Address permit application rejections in a timely manner.
Facilitate communication between surveyors, architects, engineers, etc. via email and phone.
Regularly call and email vendors and city officials to ensure timely deliverables.
Maintain database to ensure files are updated with all necessary documentation.
Maintain a knowledge of and be prepared to answer questions about the status of permits for all new construction.
Development Support
Prepare permit packages to be sent to our field development team.
File required documentation through online portals to be recorded with the appropriate county.
Procurement
Regularly solicit updated pricing among vendors to ensure we are obtaining competitive pricing.
Request purchase orders for active jobs that are under construction.
Check invoices from vendors to ensure that invoiced amounts match master pricing agreements.
Transaction Support
Prepare drafts of Purchase & Sale contracts.
Assist team in due diligence process coordination for all transactions.
Maintain closing calendars for transactions to ensure team is aware of key deadlines and terms.
Qualifications:
University degree. Four or more years of successful experience in a professional work environment
Strong skills in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel) and Adobe PDF.
Interest and use of latest AI technology products is key. Interest and curiosity in how to streamline operations through AI and technology is viewed positively.
Possess strong verbal and written English skills.
Must be highly organized and attentive to detail.
Willing to work in high-pressure environment.
Willing to be responsive and communicative.
Availability is key. Candidate must be willing to respond to time-sensitive requests outside of normal working hours. Normal working hours are 9 AM to 5 PM EST.
The team member may occasionally be asked to work weekends, but that is abnormal.
Good attitude necessary.
